description:
Send an outbound text message.

        Without ``from_``, supported destinations use the workspace's alphanumeric sender ID.
        Other destinations use an eligible workspace SMS-capable number.
        A missing required number returns 422. SMS does not use the shared voice-call pool.
        US long-code texting to US recipients requires ready A2P 10DLC registration and an attached number.
        Trial texts (only to the workspace's own verified phone, set up in the console: Overview > Test a text): without from_, Hail uses one when the workspace's own number cannot text that US phone; set from_ to the trial number to use one directly. Each starts with "[Hail trial]".

        The message purpose determines the consent checks. Marketing requires a consent source.
        Hail does not independently verify the recipient's consent.

        The result includes the delivery status and retry key. A failed carrier attempt can
        appear as a message record with status ``failed``.

body.description: Message text. Long bodies are split into carrier segments.
body.title: Body

consent_obtained_at.description: When consent was obtained, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, if known.
consent_obtained_at.title: Consent Obtained At

consent_source.description: Where or how consent was obtained, such as ``signup form``. Required when ``message_type`` is ``marketing``.
consent_source.title: Consent Source

from_.description: Sender: an active E.164 workspace number with SMS, from ``list_numbers``. Omitted: picked by destination (see the tool description).
from_.title: From

idempotency_key.description: Retry key. The ``idempotency_key`` from an earlier response refers to that original request instead of starting a new one. Omitted: a new key is generated and returned.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

message_type.description: Purpose of the communication for consent checks. Transactional or service messages are ``informational``; promotional messages are ``marketing``.
message_type.title: Message Type

metadata.description: Extra data stored on the message record.
metadata.title: Metadata

recipient_consent.description: Confirmation from the user that the recipient lawfully agreed to be contacted. Hail requires ``true`` and does not independently verify consent.
recipient_consent.title: Recipient Consent

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, such as ``+14155551234``.
to.title: To

name: send_sms

agent_id.description: The agent this text belongs to: the number's text agent on inbound texts, the agent that wrote it on outbound texts. Null when no agent is involved.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

direction.description: 'outbound' for messages Hail sent, 'inbound' for messages received.
direction.title: Direction

error_code.description: Carrier error code if delivery failed. Null on success or while pending.
error_code.title: Error Code

idempotency_key.description: Key that identifies this exact request when retrying.

organization_id.description: Organization that sent or received this message.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

provider_message_sid.description: The carrier/provider's identifier for this message, if assigned.
provider_message_sid.title: Provider Message Sid

requested_at.description: When the send was requested, ISO 8601 timestamp.
requested_at.title: Requested At

segment_count.description: Number of carrier SMS segments the body was split into.
segment_count.title: Segment Count

sent_at.description: When the message was handed to the carrier, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null until sent.
sent_at.title: Sent At

title: Send a text message
